quest.title: "Heart of Watatsumi"
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x350, Primogem x40, Hero's Wit x3, Mora x30000, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6

talks.objective: Return to Sangonomiya Shrine and talk to Tsuyuko

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: #Welcome back, {NICKNAME}. Is there something I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about your commission...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We got the four Spirit Pearls!

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Is that so? I knew I could count on you, thank you very much! Then, we are only one step away from unlocking the final seal of the "heart."

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Sorry, I have to ask you both to come along with me — I hope you don't mind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Since we're already here, a little more's no biggie! Right, {NICKNAME}?

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: There's no time to lose. Let's head off!

talks.objective: Open the gate to the "Heart of Watatsumi"

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Hmm...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Miss Tsuyuko...?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Oh— Sorry, I was quite lost in thought just then.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Thanks to your help, we have the Key of the Moon-bathed Deep in hand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Key of the Moon-shaved what now? ...And what is that, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Haha, just call it the "Key of the Deep." We're not going to insist that outlanders use all the proper names for every last thing.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: This is something we will need to open the entrance to Enkanomiya. It was forged from the very spilled blood of our Omikami...

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: ...Or at least, that's what the legends say.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Curiouser and curiouser...

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Haha! It isn't mysterious at all! In fact, it's just the opposite.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Well, now we just need to report to the Divine Priestess, await her approval, and then wait for the spirit vein flow to be correct...

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: And then, we can head down to Enkanomiya.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, then what did we do all this for?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Well, it's not as if you gained nothing during this journey, right?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: I mean... You've secured the lasting friendship of the Sangonomiya Shrine! Watatsumi Island will welcome you back any time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How about something a bit more concrete than that?

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: The records do say that the Spirit Pearls will answer the summons of someone pure, and that the Key will only come together for one whose heart is as clear as the waters themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: I don't generally believe what those texts say, but I do believe that you can turn Watatsumi Island's situation around.

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: Well then, when the time comes to go down to Enkanomiya...

response.speaker: Tsuyuko
response.text: Hehe, my fortune slip luck is pretty good. I'm certain that we'll meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Seal of the "Heart"
dialogues.text: A strange, phosphorescent seal, upon which the symbol of a fish has been graven...

talks.objective: Obtain the Key of the Deep

dialogues.speaker: Tsuyuko
dialogues.text: (Miss Tsuyuko seems to be thinking about something, so perhaps this is not the time to disturb her.)
